description: Whether Schema Commander answers, its version and the limits the user set (rows, characters, whether data may be read at all).
name: status

description: The connections of the user: id, name, kind of database (postgres, mysql, sqlserver, sqlite), whether it is open, and what you may do on it: off (nothing), schema (structure only), read (reading queries), write (writing only as a proposal the user confirms). Never contains hosts, users or passwords.
name: list_connections

description: Without `schema`: the schemas (databases) of a connection. With `schema`: its tables, views and routines with an estimated row count. Needs access `schema` or more.

connection.description: Id of a connection from list_connections.

schema.description: Name of a schema; leave out to list the schemas.

name: get_schema

description: Columns (type, nullable, default, key), indexes and foreign keys of a table or view, and its DDL where the database gives one. Needs access `schema` or more.

connection.description: Id of a connection from list_connections.

name: describe_table

description: Runs ONE statement that only reads (SELECT, WITH … SELECT, SHOW, EXPLAIN without ANALYZE) in a read-only transaction and returns the rows as JSON. Limited in rows, in characters and in time (30 s); `truncated` says when rows or text were cut. A statement that writes is refused – use propose_query. Needs access `read` or more.

connection.description: Id of a connection from list_connections.

max_rows.description: Default 200; the user's limit may be lower.

name: run_query

description: The estimated execution plan of ONE statement, as a tree with costs and row estimates. The statement is not run. Needs access `read` or more.

connection.description: Id of a connection from list_connections.

name: explain_query

description: Opens a new editor tab in the app with the text. Nothing runs: the user reads it and decides. Use it for longer scripts or for SQL the user should keep.

connection.description: Optional: the connection the tab belongs to.

text.description: The SQL or text for the tab.

name: write_to_tab

description: Proposes ONE statement to the user – the way to change data or structure. The app shows the statement, the connection and your reason; the call waits (up to 5 minutes) for the decision. Accepted, the user's app runs it with its own safeguards and you get the outcome (rows affected or the error); declined, you get `accepted: false`. A statement that writes needs access `write`.

connection.description: Id of a connection from list_connections.

reason.description: One or two sentences for the user: what it does and why.

name: propose_query
